create_ViTMSNConfig: create a ViTMSNConfig instance with default transformer hyperparameters for the ViT MSN model
configure_ViTMSN_hidden_size: configure the ViTMSNConfig hidden_size parameter to set the model embedding dimension
configure_ViTMSN_layers_heads: configure the ViTMSNConfig num_hidden_layers and num_attention_heads parameters for transformer depth and attention
initialize_ViTMSN_model: initialize a ViTMSNModel with a ViTMSNConfig instance to build the vision transformer
access_ViTMSN_config: access the ViTMSNConfig from an existing ViTMSNModel instance via the model.config attribute
